entry.title: Combined summary - Direct Messages (DMs)
entry.summary: Efforts are underway to reach out to @neonrooks with a request for their npub, which is necessary for facilitating direct support from listeners. The song "Off the Chain" by this artist has been featured on [btcplaylist.com](https://btcplaylist.com), and having the npub available would enable fans to send zaps to the creator. The absence of a direct messaging option on the forum has prompted alternative means of making contact. Emphasis is placed on ensuring that artists retain full control over their sats, underscoring a commitment to maximizing benefits for creators within the platform’s community.
